title: PRISM/A — D: Domains
description: Bounded contexts with DDD classification, ubiquitous language, and ownership. One file per landscape or per domain cluster.

domains.description: Bounded contexts. Each domain owns its data model, its ubiquitous language, and a clearly named team or stakeholder.

name.description: Human-readable domain name (noun phrase, e.g. 'Claims Processing').

description.description: What this domain is responsible for — its core purpose and boundaries.

domain_type.description: DDD strategic classification. core = competitive differentiator; supporting = necessary but not differentiating; generic = commodity, candidate for off-the-shelf solution.

maturity.description: Maturity of the domain's ownership, documentation, and practices.

owner_stakeholder_id.description: Reference to the stakeholder (team or person) who owns this domain. Cross-references PRISM EA stakeholder registry.

ubiquitous_language.description: Key terms that have precise, agreed meanings within this domain. Ubiquitous language prevents cross-domain ambiguity.

component_ids.description: IDs of components (from the C dimension) that belong to this domain.
